{{Top|leg}}
'''Tychin''' was an individual who was a subscriber to, and commenter on, [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. On the entry for the [[Hound-W2 SPD]], Tychin wondered if it was possible to use the fact that the droid had to communicate via [[Scomp link/Legends|scomp link]] to generate a false positive. By reprogramming the translation, the droid would report an intruder as normal, but the resulting communication would instead give an all-clear signal. Tychin believed that if successful, it would allow individuals to get away with less than legal activities.<ref name="CDD">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
